source-integrity.provenance: SEC filing and issuer operational evidence plus independent FT and market-data origins
source-integrity.freshness: financial filing 2026-09-03; Berlin issuer 2026-09-21; FT 2026-09-22; market 2026-09-21
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer syndication collapsed; issuer Berlin source is not independent corroboration
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: SEC/issuer, FT and market-data origins separated
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: current Scout Berlin evidence corroborates capacity expansion without treating scheduled capacity as realized utilization

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 FY2027 revenue $116.1M, +58% YoY; backlog about $814.9M; 98% recurring ACV; adjusted EBITDA positive, while GAAP loss and capital intensity remain material.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Strong liquidity is offset by ATM/share-count dilution risk and continued constellation investment.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Sovereign/defense demand supports visibility but increases procurement and concentration exposure.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Execution on growth and geographic capacity is evident; long-duration capital allocation remains mixed because GAAP losses and dilution persist.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Recurring ACV/backlog support moderate value capture; hardware mix, concentration and substitutes constrain stronger pricing-power evidence.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Berlin manufacturing opening and sovereign demand; realized utilization and award conversion remain non-gating unknowns.

thesisQuality.basis: 58% YoY revenue growth, high recurring ACV and backlog demonstrate adoption, offset by GAAP losses and hardware mix.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong revenue/backlog growth and adjusted profitability coexist with GAAP loss, capex and dilution risk.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market valuation remains demanding relative to trailing revenue despite growth.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin capacity and sovereign demand are identifiable catalysts; utilization and conversion are not yet proven.

governancePower.basis: Growth/capacity execution is credible but losses, ATM issuance and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Persistent Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence serve durable infrastructure/security needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Satellite/data capability spans government, defense and commercial uses; Berlin adds manufacturing to established European functions.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation, ground infrastructure and manufacturing capacity create meaningful capability control, though substitutes exist.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign paths diversify demand, offset by capital intensity and defense concentration.

substitutionResilience.basis: Proprietary high-cadence imagery and infrastructure create moderate barriers, but commercial/government alternatives remain.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Berlin adds geographic manufacturing capacity but launch and satellite supply dependencies remain and realized redundancy is unproven.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring ACV/backlog support moderate value capture; concentration, hardware mix and substitutes limit scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Losses, capex, dilution, concentration, substitution and valuation risks are partly offset by liquidity/backlog.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC evidence plus independent capacity/demand and valuation sources; Berlin utilization and customer economics remain undisclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled Earth-observation infrastructure plus sovereign demand and added manufacturing capacity support durable relevance, while valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog/capacity must convert into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution while competing imagery remains available.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Berlin ramp and European sovereign award conversion into revenue/cash economics.

unknowns.item: Berlin realized utilization/unit economics are undisclosed.
Long-run customer concentration/renewal economics remain uncertain.
